text: זֵֽכֶר תְּחִלַּת כָּל מַעַשׂ. אֲשֶׁר בְּכָל שָׁנָה נַעַשׂ. תּוֹחַלְתָּם לְמָאָס. יוֹצֵר בַּל יִזְכּוֹר: תּוֹכַחַת מַעַשׂ. אִם יָצְאָה בְּכַעַס. תּוֹמֵךְ לְמַעֲנוֹ יַעַשׂ. וִיצוּרִים יִזְכּוֹר: זֵֽכֶר שֶׁמִּבְּרֵאשִׁית. תְּבוּאַת רֵאשִׁית. שֹֽׁרֶשׁ בִּכּוּר רֵאשִׁית. יֵרָא וְיִזְכּוֹר: שֶֽׁצֶף חֲרִישִׁית. אִם חָר לְהָשִׁית. שׁוּבָה אֲשֶׁר הֵשִׁית. לַשּׁוֹבָבִים יִזְכֹּר: זֵֽכֶר רֹאשׁ עֲפָרוֹת. וְתוֹלְדוֹת סְפוּרוֹת. רְשׁוּם סְפוּרוֹת. לְמִסְפַּר חוֹל יִזְכּוֹר: רֹבַע מִסְפָּרוֹת. מְחַנְנֵי לְכַפָּרֹת. רֶֽגֶשׁ שׁוֹפָרֹת. לְשַׁפְּרֵם יִזְכּוֹר: זֵֽכֶר קְרִיאַת סֵֽפֶר. אֲשֶׁר גָּלְמִי שִׁפֵּר. קָצַב לוֹ בַּסֵּֽפֶר. בְּכָל דּוֹר וָדוֹר לִזְכּוֹר: קֶֽצֶב אִם

primary_changes.reason: The refrain word and mem are printed.
No vav printed (defective spelling). מִסְפָּרוֹת does have a vav.

text: אֶפְחַד בְּמַעֲשַׂי. אֶדְאַג בְּכָל עֵת. אִירָא בְּיוֹם דִּין. בְּבוֹאִי לְזִכָּרוֹן: אֶדְרוֹשׁ לְחַנּוּן. אֲחַלֶּה לְרַחוּם. אֲחַנֵּן לְחַק לִי. יוֹם לְזִכָּרוֹן: בְּבוֹאִי לְמִשְׁפָּט. בְּמִי אֶשָּׁעֵן. וּמִי יְחַפֶּשׂ לִי. צֶֽדֶק לְזִכָּרוֹן: בָּאָבוֹת בָּטַֽחְתִּי. וּפָעֳלָם אָכַֽלְתִּי. וְהֵם הָיוּ לִי. קֶֽדֶם לְזִכָּרוֹן: גָּבְרָה זְרוֹעִי. כְּשָׂח מְחֵנִי נָא. לְבַל יִמַּח מֶנִּי. שֵׁם וְזִכָּרוֹן: גֶּֽבֶר אִם יַעֲמוֹד לְפָנָיו הֲיוֹעִיל. בְּעֵת יְבֻקַּשׁ מֶנִּי. זְכוּת לְזִכָּרוֹן: דַּצְתִּי בְּלוֹבֵשׁ אֵפוֹד. וְחֹֽשֶׁן הַמִּשְׁפָּט. אֲשֶׁר בָּם הוּחַק. שְׁמִי לְזִכָּרוֹן: דִּלֵּג בְּמַחְתָּה. עַד יֵעָצֵר נֶֽגֶף. בְּגֶֽשֶׁת זָר מְכַהֵן. יָקוּד לְזִכָּרוֹן: הַבִּֽיטָה אֵל. בְּעָמְדִי לְפָנֶֽיךָ. אֵין בְּקִרְבִּי אֱנוֹשׁ. תָּוִי לְזִכָּרוֹן: הֲיֵשׁ מִי יְפַלֵּל. וְיָשִׁיב

text: On the day of memory of the beginning of all action, let the Creator not remember those of the deeds of the whole year that are in conflict with Israel’s hopes. If reproof for those deeds has gone forth in anger, may He grant help for His own sake and remember the creatures. May He look and recall the memory of the people He first appointed, the first harvest, the root of the first fruit. When in His anger He determines to send severe punishment, may He remember the atonement which He has ordained for the faithless. He remembers the first man who was formed from dust, the countless generations and the inscribed (good deeds) on behalf of the people that is like the sand in number. He remembers those counted in four camps who implore expiation and sound the Shofar in order to purify themselves. He remembers what was read out from the book that was bestowed by Him upon the first man even before its completion. He had decided in that book that He was to be remembered in every generation. text: I am anxious because of my deeds, I worry constantly, I fear on the day of judgment, when I come for remembrance. I seek out the Merciful, I entreat the Compassionate, I implore Him who has appointed this day for me for remembrance. When I come in judgment, on whom shall I rely, who will find righteousness for me as a remembrance? Upon the fathers I put my trust, I derive benefit from their work, they have from of old served as my remembrance. My arm was strong when Moses pleaded to be wiped out, so that my name should not be wiped out nor should my remembrance. Should a man stand before the Lord, can he then help me, when merit is required from me for remembrance. I rejoiced with him (Aaron) who wore the Ephod and the Breast-plate of Judgment on which my name was engraved for remembrance. He hastened with his censor until the plague had abated, when a stranger (Korah) approached to act as priest, the flames devoured him as a remembrance. Behold, O God, when I stand before Thee, there is no man in my midst whom I could designate for remembrance. Can anyone pray and turn
uncertainties: Comma after 'judgment': the primary has none and the blind reader has one. Unresolved.
